alkylation_concentration.evidence: The samples were dried down in a speedvac for 15 min before reduction with 45 nM of dithiothreitol for 30 min at 55 °C and alkylation in 100 mM iodoacetamide (30 min, in the dark).

cleavage_agent.evidence: The gel pieces were completely dried in a speedvac and placed on ice and incubated with 12.5 ng/µL of trypsin (Sigma T6567-5 × 20UG) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate for 1 h and then placed in a 37 °C incubator overnight (~16 h).

enrichment_method.evidence: The remaining sample was loaded onto a 4–20% Tris-Glycine gel and electrophoresed for 15 min at 125 V in which time the proteins migrated about 1 cm into the gel.
